steps.message:
Build a 7-slide, 16:9 PowerPoint presentation titled "1,001 Real-World Gen AI Use Cases from Google Cloud Customers" for enterprise technology leaders and digital transformation executives evaluating generative AI adoption strategies. The tone should be data-forward, strategic, and industry-grounded.

The deck opens by establishing the scale of the report (1,001 use cases, 11 industries, 6 agent types), then traces the 10× growth trajectory from 101 to 1,001 use cases over 18 months. It introduces a taxonomy framework (industries × agent types), dives into Automotive & Logistics as a representative vertical, surfaces quantified ROI highlights, synthesizes cross-industry patterns, and closes with actionable strategic takeaways for enterprise leaders.

For the industry-and-agent taxonomy slide (slide 3), present a structured matrix or grid diagram mapping 11 industry verticals against 6 agent types. For the measurable ROI highlights slide (slide 5), use a KPI card or data callout layout featuring the specific metrics (500% ROI, 30% workload reduction, 10,000+ hours saved, 6,000+ headlines in 29 hours). The Automotive & Logistics deep-dive slide (slide 4) should use a table format organizing use cases by agent type with company names and outcomes.

Do not fabricate any data, statistics, company names, or outcomes not found in source_brief.md. All figures and examples must come directly from the provided brief.


## Data Sources

1. **Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md`**  for all the subject-matter text, data tables, statistics, and figure references you may use in the presentation.
2. **Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json`**  for **structural requirements**: deck metadata (slide count, aspect ratio, audience, tone) and a per-slide outline (id, title, objective) that your presentation must follow.

## Output Requirements

Save the final PPT to `/app/output/final_deck.pptx`.

Only the correctly saved final file is needed — no additional explanation is required.

---

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — do not pause, ask questions, or wait for a reply. When encountering BLOCKING or "wait for user confirmation" instructions, make a professional judgment and proceed.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies fields such as `deck.tone` or `deck.audience`, use them to guide template, color palette, and style choices; otherwise, use your professional judgment.
3. **Do not deploy or share** — no deployment, PDF export, share links, or other post-delivery steps are needed.
4. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

1	# 1,001 Real-World Gen AI Use Cases from Google Cloud Customers
2	
3	## Source
4	
5	Google Cloud Blog — "1,001 real-world gen AI use cases from the world's leading organizations"  
6	URL: https://cloud.google.com/transform/101-real-world-generative-ai-use-cases-from-industry-leaders  
7	Published: April 12, 2024; last updated: October 9, 2025  
8	Authors: Matt Renner (President & CRO, Google Cloud), Matt A.V. Chaban (Senior Editor)
9	
10	![1,001 AI use cases from Google Cloud customers](./assets/figure_1.jpg)
11	
12	## Overview and Growth Trajectory
13	
14	Google Cloud first published its list of real-world generative AI use cases during Cloud Next 24 in April 2024, starting with 101 entries. By October 2025, the list had grown **10×** to 1,001 use cases — and the authors note this still only scratches the surface of what is becoming possible.
15	
16	The list is organized by **11 major industry groups** and within those, **6 agent types**: Customer, Employee, Creative, Code, Data, and Security. The October 2025 edition added 400 new entries (denoted with an asterisk). Organizations span top companies, governments, researchers, and startups worldwide.
17	
18	The 11 industry verticals are:
19	- Automotive & Logistics
20	- Business & Professional Services
21	- Financial Services
22	- Healthcare & Life Sciences
23	- Hospitality & Travel
24	- Manufacturing, Industrial & Electronics
25	- Media, Marketing & Gaming
26	- Public Sector & Nonprofits
27	- Retail
28	- Technology
29	- Telecommunications
30	
31	## Automotive & Logistics: Detailed Use Cases by Agent Type
32	
33	![Automotive & Logistics](./assets/figure_2.jpg)
34	
35	The Automotive & Logistics vertical provides one of the richest cross-sections of agent types. Below is a representative sample:
36	
37	| Agent Type | Organization | Use Case Summary | Key Metric / Detail |
38	|---|---|---|---|
39	| Customer | Mercedes-Benz | MBUX Virtual Assistant powered by Gemini via Vertex AI enables natural driver conversations for navigation and POI | Natural language in-car assistant |
40	| Customer | LUXGEN (Taiwan EV) | AI agent on LINE answers customer questions via Vertex AI | Reduced human CS workload by **30%** |
41	| Customer | General Motors (OnStar) | Virtual assistant with Google Cloud conversational AI recognizes speaker intent | Improved intent recognition |
42	| Customer | Volkswagen of America | myVW app virtual assistant lets drivers query owner's manuals; multimodal camera feature for dashboard indicators | Gemini multimodal capabilities |
43	| Customer | UPS Capital | DeliveryDefense Address Confidence uses ML to score delivery success likelihood | Data-driven delivery confidence |
44	| Customer | PODS / Tombras | "World's Smartest Billboard" on trucks adapted to NYC neighborhoods in real time using Gemini | **6,000+ unique headlines**, 299 neighborhoods, 29 hours |
45	| Employee | Toyota | AI platform on Google Cloud enables factory workers to build and deploy ML models | **10,000+ man-hours/year** saved |
46	| Employee | Uber | AI agents summarize CS communications and surface prior interaction context | Improved CS rep effectiveness |
47	| Employee | Rivian | Gemini in Google Workspace for instant research, accelerated learning, and rapid skill acquisition | Faster onboarding and deep research |
48	| Employee | Rivian | NotebookLM centralizes FAQ answers with verified sources and interactive chat | Reduced repetitive inquiries |
49	| Employee | Geotab | Google Workspace with Gemini for research, summarization, legal review, data filtering across 4.7M connected vehicles | Cross-functional productivity |
50	| Employee | Routematic | Migrated entire infrastructure to Google Cloud (Compute Engine, GKE) in 8 months with zero downtime | Release cycles shortened from **weeks to days** |
51	| Employee | 704 Apps | Gemini analyzes in-trip audio to measure emotional "temperature" and flag hostile language for safety alerts | Real-time safety monitoring |
52	| Code | Renault Group (Ampere) | Enterprise Gemini Code Assist understands company code base, standards, and conventions | Developer productivity for EV software |
53	
54	## Headline ROI and Impact Numbers Across Industries
55	
56	Several organizations reported quantified business outcomes:
57	
58	- **Mercari** (Japan's largest online marketplace): Anticipates **500% ROI** while reducing employee workloads by **20%** through AI-powered customer service.
59	- **LUXGEN**: Customer service agent workload reduced by **30%** with Vertex AI chatbot.
60	- **Toyota**: Factory AI platform saved over **10,000 man-hours per year**.
61	- **PODS / Tombras**: Generated **6,000+ unique ad headlines** across all 299 NYC neighborhoods in just **29 hours**.
62	- **Virgin Voyages**: Uses Veo text-to-video to create **thousands of hyper-personalized ads and emails** in a single batch without sacrificing brand voice.
63	- **Figma**: Enables organizations to create high-quality, brand-approved images and assets **in seconds**.
64	- **Commerzbank**: Making it easier than ever to reach a customer service agent via gen AI.
65	
66	## Cross-Industry Patterns
67	
68	Three dominant patterns emerge across the 1,001 use cases:
69	
70	1. **Conversational Customer Agents** are the most visible entry point — automotive (Mercedes-Benz, GM, VW, LUXGEN), financial services (Commerzbank), and retail (Mercari) all deploy AI-powered virtual assistants to handle customer queries, reduce wait times, and lower human agent workloads.
71	
72	2. **Employee Productivity Agents** are the broadest category — companies like Uber, Rivian, Geotab, and Oxa use Gemini for Google Workspace to summarize documents, accelerate research, draft content, review legal documents, and filter data across departments from HR to engineering.
73	
74	3. **Creative and Scale Agents** represent the fastest-growing frontier — Virgin Voyages' hyper-personalized video campaigns, PODS' real-time adaptive billboards, and Figma's instant brand-approved asset generation demonstrate that gen AI is moving from text into multimodal creative production at enterprise scale.
75	
76	## Key Findings
77	
78	- **10× growth in 18 months**: The list expanded from 101 to 1,001 use cases between April 2024 and October 2025, reflecting accelerating enterprise gen AI adoption.
79	- **Customer and Employee agents dominate**: Conversational assistants and workplace productivity tools are the most common deployment patterns across all 11 industries.
80	- **Measurable ROI is being achieved in production**: Organizations report outcomes including 500% ROI (Mercari), 30% workload reduction (LUXGEN), 10,000+ man-hours saved annually (Toyota), and thousands of creative assets generated in hours (Virgin Voyages, PODS).
81	- **Six agent types provide a useful adoption framework**: Customer, Employee, Creative, Code, Data, and Security agents offer enterprises a structured way to identify and prioritize gen AI opportunities.
82	- **The pace is accelerating**: With 400 new entries added in the latest update alone, the trajectory suggests enterprise gen AI deployment is still in its early exponential phase.

# 1,001 Real-World Gen AI Use Cases from Google Cloud Customers

## Source

Google Cloud Blog — "1,001 real-world gen AI use cases from the world's leading organizations"  
URL: https://cloud.google.com/transform/101-real-world-generative-ai-use-cases-from-industry-leaders  
Published: April 12, 2024; last updated: October 9, 2025  
Authors: Matt Renner (President & CRO, Google Cloud), Matt A.V. Chaban (Senior Editor)

![1,001 AI use cases from Google Cloud customers](./assets/figure_1.jpg)

## Overview and Growth Trajectory

Google Cloud first published its list of real-world generative AI use cases during Cloud Next 24 in April 2024, starting with 101 entries. By October 2025, the list had grown **10×** to 1,001 use cases — and the authors note this still only scratches the surface of what is becoming possible.

The list is organized by **11 major industry groups** and within those, **6 agent types**: Customer, Employee, Creative, Code, Data, and Security. The October 2025 edition added 400 new entries (denoted with an asterisk). Organizations span top companies, governments, researchers, and startups worldwide.

The 11 industry verticals are:
- Automotive & Logistics
- Business & Professional Services
- Financial Services
- Healthcare & Life Sciences
- Hospitality & Travel
- Manufacturing, Industrial & Electronics
- Media, Marketing & Gaming
- Public Sector & Nonprofits
- Retail
- Technology
- Telecommunications

## Automotive & Logistics: Detailed Use Cases by Agent Type

![Automotive & Logistics](./assets/figure_2.jpg)

The Automotive & Logistics vertical provides one of the richest cross-sections of agent types. Below is a representative sample:

| Agent Type | Organization | Use Case Summary | Key Metric / Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| Customer | Mercedes-Benz | MBUX Virtual Assistant powered by Gemini via Vertex AI enables natural driver conversations for navigation and POI | Natural language in-car assistant |
| Customer | LUXGEN (Taiwan EV) | AI agent on LINE answers customer questions via Vertex AI | Reduced human CS workload by **30%** |
| Customer | General Motors (OnStar) | Virtual assistant with Google Cloud conversational AI recognizes speaker intent | Improved intent recognition |
| Customer | Volkswagen of America | myVW app virtual assistant lets drivers query owner's manuals; multimodal camera feature for dashboard indicators | Gemini multimodal capabilities |
| Customer | UPS Capital | DeliveryDefense Address Confidence uses ML to score delivery success likelihood | Data-driven delivery confidence |
| Customer | PODS / Tombras | "World's Smartest Billboard" on trucks adapted to NYC neighborhoods in real time using Gemini | **6,000+ unique headlines**, 299 neighborhoods, 29 hours |
| Employee | Toyota | AI platform on Google Cloud enables factory workers to build and deploy ML models | **10,000+ man-hours/year** saved |
| Employee | Uber | AI agents summarize CS communications and surface prior interaction context | Improved CS rep effectiveness |
| Employee | Rivian | Gemini in Google Workspace for instant research, accelerated learning, and rapid skill acquisition | Faster onboarding and deep research |
| Employee | Rivian | NotebookLM centralizes FAQ answers with verified sources and interactive chat | Reduced repetitive inquiries |
| Employee | Geotab | Google Workspace with Gemini for research, summarization, legal review, data filtering across 4.7M connected vehicles | Cross-functional productivity |
| Employee | Routematic | Migrated entire infrastructure to Google Cloud (Compute Engine, GKE) in 8 months with zero downtime | Release cycles shortened from **weeks to days** |
| Employee | 704 Apps | Gemini analyzes in-trip audio to measure emotional "temperature" and flag hostile language for safety alerts | Real-time safety monitoring |
| Code | Renault Group (Ampere) | Enterprise Gemini Code Assist understands company code base, standards, and conventions | Developer productivity for EV software |

## Headline ROI and Impact Numbers Across Industries

Several organizations reported quantified business outcomes:

- **Mercari** (Japan's largest online marketplace): Anticipates **500% ROI** while reducing employee workloads by **20%** through AI-powered customer service.
- **LUXGEN**: Customer service agent workload reduced by **30%** with Vertex AI chatbot.
- **Toyota**: Factory AI platform saved over **10,000 man-hours per year**.
- **PODS / Tombras**: Generated **6,000+ unique ad headlines** across all 299 NYC neighborhoods in just **29 hours**.
- **Virgin Voyages**: Uses Veo text-to-video to create **thousands of hyper-personalized ads and emails** in a single batch without sacrificing brand voice.
- **Figma**: Enables organizations to create high-quality, brand-approved images and assets **in seconds**.
- **Commerzbank**: Making it easier than ever to reach a customer service agent via gen AI.

## Cross-Industry Patterns

Three dominant patterns emerge across the 1,001 use cases:

1. **Conversational Customer Agents** are the most visible entry point — automotive (Mercedes-Benz, GM, VW, LUXGEN), financial services (Commerzbank), and retail (Mercari) all deploy AI-powered virtual assistants to handle customer queries, reduce wait times, and lower human agent workloads.

2. **Employee Productivity Agents** are the broadest category — companies like Uber, Rivian, Geotab, and Oxa use Gemini for Google Workspace to summarize documents, accelerate research, draft content, review legal documents, and filter data across departments from HR to engineering.

3. **Creative and Scale Agents** represent the fastest-growing frontier — Virgin Voyages' hyper-personalized video campaigns, PODS' real-time adaptive billboards, and Figma's instant brand-approved asset generation demonstrate that gen AI is moving from text into multimodal creative production at enterprise scale.

## Key Findings

- **10× growth in 18 months**: The list expanded from 101 to 1,001 use cases between April 2024 and October 2025, reflecting accelerating enterprise gen AI adoption.
- **Customer and Employee agents dominate**: Conversational assistants and workplace productivity tools are the most common deployment patterns across all 11 industries.
- **Measurable ROI is being achieved in production**: Organizations report outcomes including 500% ROI (Mercari), 30% workload reduction (LUXGEN), 10,000+ man-hours saved annually (Toyota), and thousands of creative assets generated in hours (Virgin Voyages, PODS).
- **Six agent types provide a useful adoption framework**: Customer, Employee, Creative, Code, Data, and Security agents offer enterprises a structured way to identify and prioritize gen AI opportunities.
- **The pace is accelerating**: With 400 new entries added in the latest update alone, the trajectory suggests enterprise gen AI deployment is still in its early exponential phase.

"""Build the 7-slide Gen AI Use Cases PowerPoint deck."""
import os
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
from pptx.oxml import parse_xml
from lxml import etree
import copy

# ── Color palette (Google Cloud-inspired, enterprise-grade) ─────────────────
GOOGLE_BLUE   = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x73, 0xE8)   # Google Blue
GOOGLE_DARK   = RGBColor(0x17, 0x2B, 0x4B)   # Deep navy
GOOGLE_MID    = RGBColor(0x34, 0x65, 0x91)   # Mid-blue
ACCENT_TEAL   = RGBColor(0x00, 0xA3, 0x9A)   # Teal accent
ACCENT_AMBER  = RGBColor(0xFB, 0xBC, 0x04)   # Google Yellow
ACCENT_GREEN  = RGBColor(0x34, 0xA8, 0x53)   # Google Green
ACCENT_RED    = RGBColor(0xEA, 0x43, 0x35)   # Google Red
WHITE         = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
LIGHT_GRAY    = RGBColor(0xF1, 0xF3, 0xF4)
MID_GRAY      = RGBColor(0x9A, 0xA0, 0xA6)
DARK_GRAY     = RGBColor(0x3C, 0x40, 0x43)
TEXT_DARK     = RGBColor(0x20, 0x21, 0x24)

SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)


def new_prs():
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width  = SLIDE_W
    prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H
    return prs


def blank_slide(prs):
    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # truly blank
    return prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)


def add_rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill_color=None, line_color=None, line_width=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, x, y, w, h)  # MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.RECTANGLE = 1
    fill = shape.fill
    if fill_color:
        fill.solid()
        fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    else:
        fill.background()
    line = shape.line
    if line_color:
        line.color.rgb = line_color
        if line_width:
            line.width = line_width
    else:
        line.fill.background()
    shape.shadow.inherit = False
    return shape


def add_textbox(slide, x, y, w, h, text, font_size, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False, font_name="Calibri"):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    tf.auto_size = None
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return txb


def add_para(tf, text, font_size, bold=False, color=TEXT_DARK,
             align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, italic=False, space_before=0, font_name="Calibri"):
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.alignment = align
    if space_before:
        p.space_before = Pt(space_before)
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return p


def slide_header(slide, title, subtitle=None, dark_bg=True):
    """Top banner with title + optional subtitle."""
    bg_color = GOOGLE_DARK if dark_bg else GOOGLE_BLUE
    add_rect(slide, 0, 0, SLIDE_W, Inches(1.25), fill_color=bg_color)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.4), Inches(0.12), Inches(12.5), Inches(0.65),
                title, 22, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
    if subtitle:
        add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.4), Inches(0.75), Inches(12.5), Inches(0.4),
                    subtitle, 11, bold=False, color=RGBColor(0xBD, 0xC1, 0xC6),
                    align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)


def slide_footer(slide, text="Source: Google Cloud Blog · 1,001 Real-World Gen AI Use Cases · October 2025"):
    add_rect(slide, 0, Inches(7.2), SLIDE_W, Inches(0.3), fill_color=GOOGLE_DARK)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.3), Inches(7.2), Inches(12.7), Inches(0.3),
                text, 7, color=MID_GRAY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 1 – Title / Cover
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def build_slide1(prs):
    slide = blank_slide(prs)

    # Full dark background
    add_rect(slide, 0, 0, SLIDE_W, SLIDE_H, fill_color=GOOGLE_DARK)

    # Blue accent stripe on left
    add_rect(slide, 0, 0, Inches(0.12), SLIDE_H, fill_color=GOOGLE_BLUE)

    # Decorative circles (top right)
    for i, (cx, cy, r, alpha) in enumerate([
        (Inches(11.8), Inches(0.4),  Inches(1.8), 0x1A),
        (Inches(13.0), Inches(1.2),  Inches(2.4), 0x12),
        (Inches(11.0), Inches(1.5),  Inches(1.2), 0x0E),
    ]):
        sh = slide.shapes.add_shape(9, cx - r, cy - r, r*2, r*2)  # oval
        sh.fill.solid()
        sh.fill.fore_color.rgb = GOOGLE_BLUE
        sh.line.fill.background()
        # make semi-transparent via XML
        sp_pr = sh.fill._xPr
        # use lxml to set lumMod for slight tint effect; skip exact alpha for compat

    # Google Cloud wordmark area
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.4), Inches(0.5), Inches(5), Inches(0.5),
                "GOOGLE CLOUD", 11, bold=True,
                color=ACCENT_AMBER, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    # Main title
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.4), Inches(1.2), Inches(9.8), Inches(2.5))
    tf = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p1 = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p1.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT
    r1 = p1.add_run()
    r1.text = "1,001 Real-World"
    r1.font.size = Pt(42)
    r1.font.bold = True
    r1.font.color.rgb = WHITE
    r1.font.name = "Calibri"

    add_para(tf, "Gen AI Use Cases", 42, bold=True, color=GOOGLE_BLUE,
             align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, space_before=2)
    add_para(tf, "from Google Cloud Customers", 32, bold=False, color=WHITE,
             align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, space_before=4)

    # Stat pills
    stats = [
        ("1,001", "Use Cases"),
        ("11",    "Industries"),
        ("6",     "Agent Types"),
        ("10×",   "Growth in 18 Months"),
    ]
    pill_x = Inches(0.4)
    pill_y = Inches(4.0)
    pill_w = Inches(2.8)
    pill_h = Inches(1.0)
    gap    = Inches(0.2)
    for num, label in stats:
        add_rect(slide, pill_x, pill_y, pill_w, pill_h, fill_color=GOOGLE_MID)
        add_textbox(slide, pill_x + Inches(0.12), pill_y + Inches(0.04),
                    pill_w - Inches(0.24), Inches(0.52),
                    num, 28, bold=True, color=ACCENT_AMBER, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        add_textbox(slide, pill_x + Inches(0.12), pill_y + Inches(0.56),
                    pill_w - Inches(0.24), Inches(0.38),
                    label, 9, bold=False, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        pill_x += pill_w + gap

    # Subtitle line
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.4), Inches(5.3), Inches(10), Inches(0.45),
                "Updated October 2025  ·  Originally published April 2024 (Cloud Next 24)  ·  10× growth from 101 entries",
                10, color=MID_GRAY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.4), Inches(5.85), Inches(10), Inches(0.9),
                "A structured overview of how the world's leading organizations are deploying generative AI\n"
                "across 11 industry verticals and 6 agent types — with measurable, production results.",
                11, color=RGBColor(0xBD, 0xC1, 0xC6), align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    slide_footer(slide)
    return slide


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 2 – Growth Trajectory
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def build_slide2(prs):
    slide = blank_slide(prs)
    add_rect(slide, 0, 0, SLIDE_W, SLIDE_H, fill_color=LIGHT_GRAY)

    slide_header(slide,
                 "From 101 to 1,001: Gen AI Adoption Grew 10× in 18 Months",
                 "Enterprise gen AI deployment is still in early exponential phase — and accelerating")

    # Timeline track
    track_y  = Inches(3.5)
    track_x1 = Inches(1.0)
    track_x2 = Inches(12.2)
    track_h  = Inches(0.08)
    add_rect(slide, track_x1, track_y, track_x2 - track_x1, track_h,
             fill_color=GOOGLE_MID)

    # Arrow head (right side)
    arr = slide.shapes.add_shape(13, track_x2 - Inches(0.1), track_y - Inches(0.15),
                                  Inches(0.3), track_h + Inches(0.3))
    arr.fill.solid()
    arr.fill.fore_color.rgb = GOOGLE_BLUE
    arr.line.fill.background()

    # Milestones
    milestones = [
        (track_x1,              "April 2024",  "Cloud Next 24",     "101",  "Use Cases",
         GOOGLE_BLUE, Inches(1.5)),
        (Inches(6.6),           "mid-2025",    "Ongoing growth",    "~500", "Approx. midpoint",
         ACCENT_TEAL, Inches(1.5)),
        (track_x2 - Inches(0.5),"October 2025","Latest update",    "1,001","Use Cases (+400 new)",
         ACCENT_GREEN, Inches(1.5)),
    ]

    for mx, date_lbl, event_lbl, num, desc, col, box_w in milestones:
        # Dot on track
        dot_r = Inches(0.18)
        dot = slide.shapes.add_shape(9, mx - dot_r, track_y - dot_r + track_h/2,

        dot.fill.solid()

        # Box above track
        box_h  = Inches(1.3)

        box_x  = mx - box_w / 2
        add_rect(slide, box_x, box_y, box_w, box_h, fill_color=col)
        add_textbox(slide, box_x + Inches(0.1), box_y + Inches(0.08),
                    box_w - Inches(0.2), Inches(0.55),
                    num, 30, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        add_textbox(slide, box_x + Inches(0.1), box_y + Inches(0.60),

                    desc, 8, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

        # Label below track
        add_textbox(slide, mx - Inches(1.1), track_y + Inches(0.25),

    # 10× callout

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(4.9), Inches(4.8), Inches(3.5), Inches(0.7),

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(4.9), Inches(5.45), Inches(3.5), Inches(0.35),

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(4.9), Inches(5.8), Inches(3.5), Inches(0.35),
                "400 new entries in latest update alone", 9,
                color=MID_GRAY, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    # Key insight
    add_rect(slide, Inches(0.3), Inches(6.55), Inches(12.7), Inches(0.5),
             fill_color=GOOGLE_BLUE)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(6.57), Inches(12.3), Inches(0.45),
                "\"The 1,001 entries still only scratch the surface of what is becoming possible.\" "
                "— Matt Renner, President & CRO, Google Cloud",
                10, italic=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    slide_footer(slide)
    return slide

"""Build the 7-slide Gen AI Use Cases PowerPoint deck."""

SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)


def new_prs():

def blank_slide(prs):
    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # truly blank

def add_rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill_color=None, line_color=None, line_width=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, x, y, w, h)  # MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.RECTANGLE = 1
    fill = shape.fill
    if fill_color:
        fill.solid()
        fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    else:
        fill.background()
    line = shape.line
    if line_color:
        line.color.rgb = line_color
        if line_width:
            line.width = line_width
    else:
        line.fill.background()
    shape.shadow.inherit = False
    return shape


def add_textbox(slide, x, y, w, h, text, font_size, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False, font_name="Calibri"):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    tf.auto_size = None
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return txb


def add_para(tf, text, font_size, bold=False, color=TEXT_DARK,
             align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, italic=False, space_before=0, font_name="Calibri"):
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.alignment = align
    if space_before:
        p.space_before = Pt(space_before)
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return p

def add_rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill_color=None, line_color=None, line_width=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, x, y, w, h)  # MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.RECTANGLE = 1
    fill = shape.fill
    if fill_color:
        fill.solid()
        fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    else:
        fill.background()
    line = shape.line
    if line_color:
        line.color.rgb = line_color
        if line_width:
            line.width = line_width
    else:
        line.fill.background()
    shape.shadow.inherit = False
    return shape


def add_textbox(slide, x, y, w, h, text, font_size, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False, font_name="Calibri"):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    tf.auto_size = None
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    run.font.name = font_name
    return txb

             align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, italic=False, space_before=0, font_name="Calibri"):
    p = tf.add_paragraph()

    run = p.add_run()

    run.font.size = Pt(font_size)

    run.font.color.rgb = color

    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, x, y, w, h)  # MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.RECTANGLE = 1
    fill = shape.fill
    if fill_color:
        fill.solid()
        fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color

    line = shape.line
    if line_color:
        line.color.rgb = line_color
        if line_width:

    else:
        line.fill.background()
    shape.shadow.inherit = False

                align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False, font_name="Calibri"):

        add_textbox(slide, col_x[1] + Inches(0.06), ry + Inches(0.04),
                    col_w[1] - Inches(0.14), row_h - Inches(0.06),
                    org, 8, bold=True, color=TEXT_DARK, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

        # Description cell
        add_rect(slide, col_x[2], ry, col_w[2] - Inches(0.04), row_h - Inches(0.02),
                 fill_color=row_bg, line_color=RGBColor(0xDA, 0xDC, 0xE0))
        add_textbox(slide, col_x[2] + Inches(0.06), ry + Inches(0.02),
                    col_w[2] - Inches(0.14), row_h - Inches(0.02),
                    desc, 7.5, color=TEXT_DARK, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    slide_footer(slide)
    return slide


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 5 – Quantified ROI Highlights (KPI cards)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def build_slide5(prs):
    slide = blank_slide(prs)
    add_rect(slide, 0, 0, SLIDE_W, SLIDE_H, fill_color=GOOGLE_DARK)

    slide_header(slide,
                 "Quantified Impact: 500% ROI, 30% Workload Reduction, 10,000 Hours Saved",
                 "Production results — not pilots. These outcomes are from live deployments across industries.",
                 dark_bg=True)

    kpis = [
        ("500%",        "Anticipated ROI",
         "Mercari",     "Japan's largest online marketplace\nalso reducing employee workloads by 20%\nthrough AI-powered customer service",
         ACCENT_AMBER),
        ("30%",         "Workload Reduction",
         "LUXGEN",      "Taiwan EV maker\nCustomer service agent workload cut\nvia Vertex AI conversational chatbot",
         ACCENT_GREEN),
        ("10,000+",     "Man-Hours Saved / Year",
         "Toyota",      "Factory AI platform on Google Cloud\nenables workers to build & deploy\nML models without data science expertise",
         GOOGLE_BLUE),
        ("6,000+",      "Unique Ad Headlines",
         "PODS / Tombras","Generated across all 299 NYC neighborhoods\nin just 29 hours using Gemini\n\"World's Smartest Billboard\" campaign",
         ACCENT_TEAL),
    ]

    card_w  = Inches(3.0)
    card_h  = Inches(4.5)
    gap     = Inches(0.22)
    total_w = 4 * card_w + 3 * gap
    start_x = (SLIDE_W - total_w) / 2
    card_y  = Inches(1.5)

    for i, (metric, label, org, desc, color) in enumerate(kpis):
        cx = start_x + i * (card_w + gap)

        # Card background
        add_rect(slide, cx, card_y, card_w, card_h,
                 fill_color=RGBColor(0x1E, 0x35, 0x5C))

        # Top color band
        add_rect(slide, cx, card_y, card_w, Inches(0.22), fill_color=color)

        # Big metric number
        add_textbox(slide, cx + Inches(0.12), card_y + Inches(0.3),
                    card_w - Inches(0.24), Inches(1.2),
                    metric, 44, bold=True, color=color, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

        # Metric label
        add_textbox(slide, cx + Inches(0.12), card_y + Inches(1.45),
                    card_w - Inches(0.24), Inches(0.4),
                    label, 10, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

        # Divider line
        add_rect(slide, cx + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(1.9),
                 card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(0.03), fill_color=color)

        # Organization name
        add_textbox(slide, cx + Inches(0.12), card_y + Inches(2.0),
                    card_w - Inches(0.24), Inches(0.35),
                    org, 11, bold=True, color=color, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

        # Description
        add_textbox(slide, cx + Inches(0.14), card_y + Inches(2.4),
                    card_w - Inches(0.28), Inches(1.8),
                    desc, 9, color=RGBColor(0xBD, 0xC1, 0xC6), align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    # Bottom note
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(6.3), Inches(12.3), Inches(0.35),
                "Additional production results: Virgin Voyages — thousands of hyper-personalized video ads via Veo  ·  "
                "Figma — brand-approved assets generated in seconds  ·  Commerzbank — frictionless customer service routing",
                8.5, color=MID_GRAY, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    slide_footer(slide, "Source: Google Cloud Blog · All figures from live production deployments · October 2025")
    return slide


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 6 – Cross-Industry Patterns (3-column icon layout)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def build_slide6(prs):
    slide = blank_slide(prs)
    add_rect(slide, 0, 0, SLIDE_W, SLIDE_H, fill_color=WHITE)

    slide_header(slide,
                 "Common Patterns: Customer Assistants, Employee Productivity, and Creative Scale",
                 "Three dominant patterns emerge across 1,001 use cases — spanning every major industry")

    columns = [
        {
            "title":   "1. Conversational Customer Agents",
            "subtitle":"Most Visible Entry Point",
            "color":   GOOGLE_BLUE,
            "icon":    "💬",
            "bullets": [
                "Mercedes-Benz — MBUX Virtual Assistant",

        },

            "bullets": [

        },

            "subtitle":"Fastest-Growing Frontier",
            "color":   ACCENT_AMBER,
            "icon":    "🚀",
            "bullets": [

        },
    ]

    col_w   = Inches(4.0)
    col_h   = Inches(5.1)
    gap     = Inches(0.25)
    total_w = 3 * col_w + 2 * gap
    start_x = (SLIDE_W - total_w) / 2
    col_y   = Inches(1.38)

    for ci, col in enumerate(columns):
        cx = start_x + ci * (col_w + gap)
        color = col["color"]

        # Column card background
        add_rect(slide, cx, col_y, col_w, col_h,
                 fill_color=LIGHT_GRAY,
                 line_color=RGBColor(0xDA, 0xDC, 0xE0))

        # Top color band
        add_rect(slide, cx, col_y, col_w, Inches(0.18), fill_color=color)

        # Title
        add_textbox(slide, cx + Inches(0.14), col_y + Inches(0.22),
                    col_w - Inches(0.28), Inches(0.45),
                    col["title"], 10.5, bold=True, color=GOOGLE_DARK, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

        # Subtitle badge
        add_rect(slide, cx + Inches(0.14), col_y + Inches(0.68),
                 col_w - Inches(0.28), Inches(0.26), fill_color=color)
        add_textbox(slide, cx + Inches(0.16), col_y + Inches(0.7),
                    col_w - Inches(0.32), Inches(0.22),
                    col["subtitle"], 8, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

        # Bullet examples
        bullet_y = col_y + Inches(1.02)
        for bullet in col["bullets"]:
            txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(cx + Inches(0.14), bullet_y,
                                           col_w - Inches(0.28), Inches(0.38))
            tf = txb.text_frame
            tf.word_wrap = True
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
            p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT
            run = p.add_run()
            run.text = "• " + bullet
            run.font.size = Pt(8)
            run.font.color.rgb = TEXT_DARK
            run.font.name = "Calibri"
            bullet_y += Inches(0.38)

        # Insight box at bottom of card
        insight_y = col_y + col_h - Inches(1.1)
        add_rect(slide, cx + Inches(0.1), insight_y,
                 col_w - Inches(0.2), Inches(0.95), fill_color=color)
        add_textbox(slide, cx + Inches(0.16), insight_y + Inches(0.08),
                    col_w - Inches(0.32), Inches(0.8),
                    col["insight"], 7.5, italic=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    return slide


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 7 – Strategic Takeaways
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def build_slide7(prs):
    slide = blank_slide(prs)
    add_rect(slide, 0, 0, SLIDE_W, SLIDE_H, fill_color=GOOGLE_DARK)

    # Header
    slide_header(slide,
                 "Takeaways: Where to Start and What to Expect from Enterprise Gen AI",
                 "Five strategic imperatives for enterprise leaders evaluating gen AI adoption",
                 dark_bg=True)

    takeaways = [
        {
            "num":   "01",
            "title": "Gen AI Is Production-Ready — Across All Major Industries",
            "body":  "1,001 documented use cases across 11 verticals prove this is no longer experimental. "
                     "Customer assistants, productivity tools, and creative agents are live in automotive, "
                     "financial services, healthcare, retail, and beyond.",
            "color": GOOGLE_BLUE,
        },
        {
            "num":   "02",
            "title": "Customer & Employee Agents Are the Most Common Entry Points",
            "body":  "Conversational customer assistants (Mercedes-Benz, GM, LUXGEN, Mercari) and employee "
                     "productivity tools (Uber, Rivian, Geotab) dominate deployments. They offer fast "
                     "time-to-value with measurable ROI.",
            "color": ACCENT_TEAL,
        },
        {
            "num":   "03",
            "title": "Measurable ROI Is Achievable Within Months",
            "body":  "500% anticipated ROI (Mercari), 30% workload reduction (LUXGEN), 10,000+ hours saved "
                     "annually (Toyota), and 6,000+ creative assets in 29 hours (PODS) — these are "
                     "production results, not projections from pilots.",
            "color": ACCENT_AMBER,
        },
        {
            "num":   "04",
            "title": "Creative & Code Agents Are Emerging Fast",
            "body":  "Multimodal creative production (Virgin Voyages, PODS, Figma) and AI-assisted software "
                     "development (Renault Ampere) are the next wave. Organizations investing now will "
                     "compound advantages as capabilities mature.",
            "color": ACCENT_GREEN,
        },
        {
            "num":   "05",
            "title": "The Pace Is Accelerating — Early Movers Gain Compounding Advantages",
            "body":  "400 new use cases in the latest update alone; 10× growth in 18 months. "
                     "The 6-agent-type framework (Customer, Employee, Creative, Code, Data, Security) "
                     "gives leaders a structured path to map their own opportunity landscape.",
            "color": ACCENT_RED,
        },
    ]

    row_h   = Inches(0.95)
    row_gap = Inches(0.1)
    start_y = Inches(1.42)
    num_w   = Inches(0.7)
    title_w = Inches(3.8)
    body_w  = Inches(7.8)
    col1_x  = Inches(0.35)
    col2_x  = col1_x + num_w + Inches(0.15)
    col3_x  = col2_x + title_w + Inches(0.2)

    for i, t in enumerate(takeaways):
        ry = start_y + i * (row_h + row_gap)
        color = t["color"]

        # Number badge
        add_rect(slide, col1_x, ry + Inches(0.1), num_w, row_h - Inches(0.2),
                 fill_color=color)
        add_textbox(slide, col1_x, ry + Inches(0.15), num_w, row_h - Inches(0.25),
                    t["num"], 20, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

        # Title
        add_rect(slide, col2_x, ry, title_w, row_h,
                 fill_color=RGBColor(0x1E, 0x35, 0x5C))
        add_textbox(slide, col2_x + Inches(0.12), ry + Inches(0.08),
                    title_w - Inches(0.2), row_h - Inches(0.12),
                    t["title"], 9.5, bold=True, color=color, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

        # Body
        add_rect(slide, col3_x, ry, body_w, row_h,
                 fill_color=RGBColor(0x17, 0x2B, 0x4B))
        add_textbox(slide, col3_x + Inches(0.14), ry + Inches(0.08),
                    body_w - Inches(0.24), row_h - Inches(0.12),
                    t["body"], 8.5, color=RGBColor(0xBD, 0xC1, 0xC6), align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    # Call to action box
    add_rect(slide, Inches(0.35), Inches(6.35), Inches(12.6), Inches(0.65),
             fill_color=GOOGLE_BLUE)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(6.38), Inches(12.3), Inches(0.55),
                "Use the 11-industry × 6-agent-type framework to map your organization's gen AI landscape — "
                "start with Customer or Employee agents for fastest time-to-value, then expand to Creative, Code, Data, and Security.",
                10.5, bold=False, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    slide_footer(slide, "Source: Google Cloud Blog · 1,001 Real-World Gen AI Use Cases · Matt Renner & Matt A.V. Chaban · October 2025")
    return slide


# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def main():
    os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
    prs = new_prs()

    build_slide1(prs)
    build_slide2(prs)
    build_slide3(prs)
    build_slide4(prs)
    build_slide5(prs)
    build_slide6(prs)
    build_slide7(prs)

    out_path = "/app/output/final_deck.pptx"
    prs.save(out_path)
    print(f"Saved: {out_path}")
    print(f"Slides: {len(prs.slides)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
